**Pointer: the cross-check list in this card's Shape section is now incomplete.** No state change; add one record and one sentence.

This card asks the writer to cross-check the mirror against **ADR-0093** (tenancy mode and membership lifecycle) and **ADR-0105** (group tenancy posture) so it does not restate what a local record already decides. Since it was filed, a third local record lands on the same surface: **ADR-0131** (merged 2026-09-04, #14976), which decides organization ownership for every row in the system.

It touches this mirror's D4 directly — *"control-plane roster reads: `sys_member` becomes org-scoped"*:

- **D1/D9**: a row with an organization column was written by that organization, the column is `NOT NULL`, and a missing stamp is refused in **every** posture. "Org-scoped" is no longer a property some objects opt into; it is the default and the exceptions are the tables with **no** column.
- **D7**: whether `sys_member` keeps a column at all is a **writer-facts** question, and #15207 (C6) is the census that answers it. ⛔ Do not decide it in this ADR — cite C6 and let the census speak, exactly as this card already says to cite ADR-0093 rather than duplicate it.

So: add ADR-0131 to the cross-check list, and where D4 would restate "org-scoped", cite ADR-0131 D1/D7 instead. ⛔ Nothing new is decided here that the cloud record did not decide — the same discipline this card already carries.

Refs: ADR-0131 D1/D7/D9 · #15207 (C6) · #15194 · #14496 · cloud ADR-0081 · ADR-0093 · ADR-0105.

**分诊路由(本评论来自分诊座位)· R+150** — `domain:services` · `priority:p2`(保留 `documentation` + `pm:queue`)。

判据(实测):D1 的「加同事」走 better-auth invitations —— `git grep -rln "invitation"` 在 `packages/plugins` 与 `packages/platform-objects/src/identity` 下得 **plugin-auth 50 命中** vs platform-objects 7、plugin-security 11 ⇒ 机制主体在 services 车道。D3 的渲染半边在 objectui,按卡面**只引用不书写**,⛔ 不因此拆卡。

三份镜像同车道的理由与 p2 判据见父单 #14496 评论 `5545404025`。受管面 ⇒ draft PR + 人工合并。

⭐ 本卡有一条晚于正文的指针评论(`5536478826`,2026-09-04T06:11Z):ADR-0131 已合,须加进交叉核对表,且 D4 ⛔ 不自行判定 `sys_member` 是否保留列(引 C6 普查 #15207)。认领前请读它。

⚠️ This card's Shape section currently says, under "Stays in cloud, cited as `cloud ADR-0081`": *"D2 multi-org machinery closes into `@objectstack/organizations` (enterprise)"*. That is the sentence ADR-0132 makes historical. Everything else about this card is untouched — **D1, D3 and D4 are exactly as scoped here**, and ADR-0132 says so explicitly and does not restate any of them.

⛔ **Two writers must not both write the ADR-0081 record.** ADR-0132 carries the `## Provenance` section this card asks for (naming cloud ADR-0081 and its 2026-07-09 date, with the commercial half left in cloud), so when this card is picked up:

- **extend ADR-0132** with the D1/D3/D4 decisions and their code anchors, rather than opening a second local mirror of the same cloud record — two open ADRs mirroring one cloud record is the shape the mirror was supposed to prevent;
- ⛔ do not re-derive or restate D2 — cite ADR-0132's decisions;
- the follow-ups this card lists are unaffected: the cloud repo's one-line pointer is still owed (ADR-0132 says it belongs to the cloud PR, not to #16215), and #14361's re-pointing of the bare `ADR-0081` citations in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` and `plugin-auth` still has to choose a number — after ADR-0132 lands, the identity-surface citations that mean **D1** should point at whichever number carries D1, not at 0132.

I found this card unstarted at the time of writing (`pm:queue`, unassigned, no branch, no PR, last touched 2026-09-04 by the triage seat), so no text of yours was adopted or competed with. If it has moved since, ADR-0132's D2 reversal is the only part #16215 claims — take the rest.

⚠️ I judged the `Clause-②` myself rather than copying the `no` in the card body — a declaration transcribed is not a declaration. Same answer: an ADR that restates a ruling already made moves nothing anyone can call, parse or be refused by. If drafting it turns out to require a code or metadata change, ⛔ **stop and report** — that changes the declaration.

## ⛔ Two hard constraints before anything else

1. **`docs/adr/**` is a GOVERNED surface: draft PR, human merge.** ⛔ Never flip this out of draft, ⛔ never arm auto-merge. Not on green CI, not on a clean review. The card states it and it is binding on me too.
2. ⛔ **Decide nothing.** This is a MIRROR. Everything in the new file must already be decided in cloud `ADR-0081` (Accepted, 2026-07-09) or in this repo's code. If you find a gap where the cloud record is silent, ⛔ do not fill it — report it as an open question.

## ⭐ The collision that is actually likely here — the ADR NUMBER

The card says "next free number". ⚠️ PR **#16215** is open right now and titled *"…bring the multi-organization runtime back to open core … **(ADR-0132)**"* — a different seat, the same subject area. Two cards both taking "the next free number" is how two ADRs end up as the same number.

**Derive the number from the tree, not from the card, and re-derive it immediately before you commit** (`ls docs/adr/`), and ⭐ **check #16215's branch too** — a number that is free on `main` is not free if an open PR already claims it. Say in your report which number you took and what you checked it against. If the only safe answer is ambiguous, report it rather than guessing.

## What to write

A local ADR stating, **as this repo enforces them**, the open-mechanism half of cloud ADR-0081:

- **D1** — basic "add a teammate" stays OPEN and always goes through better-auth invitations (`sys_invitation`, the invite entry toolbar).
- **D3** — the in-shell surface is the org RECORD page reached by a `{current_org_id}` nav deep-link, opening on tab-0 Members. ⚠️ **The renderer lives in objectui**: state the contract *this repo's metadata declares* and **cite** objectui for the rendering half. ⛔ Do not describe objectui behaviour as though this repo enforced it.
- **D4** — control-plane roster reads: `sys_member` becomes org-scoped, and the org-capability gate cites "ADR-0081 D1".

**Stays in cloud, cited as `cloud ADR-0081`**: D2 (multi-org machinery closing into `@objectstack/organizations`), the non-goals, and the commercial consequences. ⛔ Do not restate those here.

## Shape

Copy `docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md`. `## Provenance — read this before citing this file` comes **first**: original decision in `objectstack-ai/cloud` ADR-0081, 2026-07-09; the enterprise half stays there; this file written from the cloud record plus the implementing code.

⭐ **Cross-check against ADR-0093 (tenancy mode and membership lifecycle) and ADR-0105 (group tenancy posture, which already links out to cloud) — where a local record already decides a point, CITE it instead of duplicating it.** A mirror that re-decides what a local ADR already says is the drift this whole exercise exists to stop.

## Every anchor must be re-located

The card cites `sys-member.object.ts:47`, `invite-entry-toolbar.test.ts:4`, `sys-user.object.ts:59`. ⛔ **Do not copy a single one of those offsets.** The card is four days old and the org surface is under active change (#16130 is dispatched, #16215 is open). Re-locate each anchor on current `origin/main`, cite what you actually find, and report anything that moved or no longer exists — a wrong anchor in a governed ADR is worse than no anchor.

## ⛔ Not this card

The two follow-ups belong to the accepting seat: the cloud-repo pointer comment, and **#14361**'s re-pointing of the bare `ADR-0081` citations across `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` and `plugin-auth`. ⛔ Do not touch those files.

Read the card's **three existing comments** before you start — the body alone is not the card. ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/`. ⛔ Do not predict CI state in the PR body.

## ⛔ My briefing was wrong on one point — owning it here, where I made the error

@hotlong — PR **#16267** delivers this card, but it opened a **second local mirror (`ADR-0133`)** instead of extending ADR-0132, which is contrary to your pointer 5557377980.

**That is my fault, not the dev seat's.** I dispatched from this card's **body alone** and never read its comments — even though the triage comment 5545413919 says, in as many words, **「认领前请读它」**. So my brief framed #16215 as a *number* collision when you had framed it as a *writer* collision. The seat read your pointer, saw it contradicted its binding brief, ⛔ refused to resolve the conflict silently, and recorded it in both its report and the ADR body. Correct behaviour on its part; the failure was mine, one step earlier.

⚠️ This is the second time this session that reading a card's body but not its comment history has cost me. It is now a fixed step in my dispatch, not a resolution.

**The full decision, with two measurements that bear on it, is on the PR: #16267 (comment 5558242242).** The short version:

1. **ADR-0132 is not on `origin/main`** (`grep -c 0132` → 0; highest is 0131) — it exists only on #16215's draft branch, so extending it means basing this branch on an unmerged governed PR.
2. ⭐ **ADR-0132 already has its own D1, D3 and D4**, and they are *different decisions* from cloud ADR-0081's D1/D3/D4. Folding this card's into that file gives one record two different D1s. ADR-0132's own body says *"D1, D3 and D4 of that record are untouched."*

⛔ I have **not** treated either as overruling you — the A/B choice (land `0133` disjoint, or hold this card until #16215 merges and extend that file) is yours, and it is a human-merge surface anyway. If the answer is B I will hold the card; the written text becomes the extension rather than being wasted.

Your other pointer (5536478826) **was** honoured in full: ADR-0131 D1/D7/D9 are in the cross-check, and ⛔ D4 does not decide whether `sys_member` keeps its column — it cites the C6 census (#15207) and lets it speak.

One out-of-scope finding filed rather than fixed: **#16270** — the org record page's tab-0 Members ordering is asserted in three documents but declared by no metadata.
